Roles at Stripe

Role details
Backend Engineer, Intelligent Commerce
Who we are
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The LPM Partner Success team is on a mission to capture a massive opportunity for Stripe: Aligning Stripe’s PIV with global payment method trends. We do this by arming integration teams with the tools they need to ship full-featured LPMs faster, and we give LPM partners the ability to independently grow and maintain their businesses on Stripe. We own the 3P Platform, Turnkey, and the LPM Partner Dashboard, powering 26+ payment methods. Our vision: building an LPM on Stripe should be as simple as deploying an app to an app store. We provide the tooling so every integration ships full-featured out of the box, and we build self-serve tools that let partners debug, monitor, and grow without Stripe in the critical path. Global teams focus on strategy and differentiation, not implementation.

What you’ll do

While most Stripe platform teams focus on internal users or merchants, this team supports LPM partners. You'll design systems where a single abstraction can improve the integration quality for 26+ payment methods. You’ll deeply understand the needs of our LPM partners and develop tools that will make Stripe the best in class partner for LPMs. To ensure every LPM launches with Stripe's core ecosystem from day one, you will work closely with teams like OCS, Billing, and Risk.

Responsibilities
Build platforms that improve the feature completeness of 10+ local payment methods at once (recurring, cross-border, adaptive pricing)
Ship features on the LPM Partner Dashboard, a greenfield product that gives partners visibility and control over their integration with Stripe
Design self-serve workflows that let partners debug, monitor, and operate independently without pulling in Stripe engineers
Streamline the LPM integration process so global teams can onboard new payment methods faster
Work with OCS, Billing, Risk, and other teams to ensure LPM integrations support critical Stripe products
Debug and resolve production issues across the stack
Mentor engineers on the team
Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements
Strong coding skills in any programming language
Strong collaboration skills, can work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success
Have the ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy, responsibility, and think of yourself as entrepreneurial
Interest in working as a generalist across varying technologies and stacks to solve problems and delight both internal and external users
Experience building, maintaining, and running production services and backend APIs
Deep care for users' needs and a track record of building great user experiences
Preferred qualifications
Experience designing multi-tenant platforms or systems that need to generalize across many similar-but-different use cases
Familiarity with payments infrastructure or payment method integrations
Experience building for external partner ecosystems where you don't control the other side of the integration
In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $156,800 - $235,200. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now
